statement: Implement H2 source/IR/deployment policy cutover: one Fetch entry in defineService({ name, version, operations, fetch, mount, dependencies }), zero/one/many-operation registry, canonical service-cell-v2 target, async Fetch guest entry generator, service ingress mount with path-segment matching, overlapping-mount rejection, URL canonicalization, host-enforced service/dependency authority, and explicit old-artifact refusal.
